role_and_alignment.route_role: Quick-separation slot route runner; option/choice routes, short and intermediate volume; vertical usage limited by frame, not speed.

2022 production came with a true-freshman QB; 2021 with an NFL-drafted QB (Howell). Production robust to QB change.
